remarks: Supremely Elegant Condo Near Downtown and Metro North to NYC! Centrally located in the extremely desirable high-rise building of Hayes House Condominiums, this 2BR/2BA property affords access to a rich array of sought-after amenities, such as a community room, fitness/health center, 24-hour security, bike storage, concierge, onsite superintendent, private storage locker, and a courtyard with grills. Fashioned with a sophisticated aesthetic, the corner unit features beautiful parquet flooring, crown molding, an openly flowing layout, ample natural light, and a sizeable living room with sliding glass doors to the outdoor space. Dine alfresco on the covered balcony, or simply enjoy a warm cup of coffee, as you bask in the lovely east-facing views. Create delicious meals in the upgraded kitchen, which has stainless-steel appliances, white cabinetry, and an adjoining dining area. Wonderfully sized for both form and function, the west facing primary bedroom boasts stunning tilework, step-in shower, and a pedestal sink. One extra bedroom (west-facing) accommodates guests, while the full guest bathroom has a multigenerational-friendly shower/tub combo. Other features: secure garage parking, available guest parking, community laundry, HOA includes heat, cooling, and hot water, near I-95, parks, shops, beach, medical facilities, LA Fitness, and public transit, and more! Enjoy being steps from highly-rated restaurants in Downtown Stamford, and start living the urban lifestyle you crave!
